Main.dc.html.title: Overview — six practice tools from the guide

row2.text: After the turn · After the game · The habit

s1.text:
Mulligan Lab — The Mulligan · Resource Management

Why it helps: objective feedback on the one decision you make every game, measured the way the chapter defines a good hand (curve, ink drops, plan card), not by how strong the cards look.

Dojo hook: a Grade button in the mulligan modal (Feature 25). Deck and hand are already in state. Size S.

Left out (YAGNI): matchup card values, on-play draw effects in the sim.

s2.text:
Race Clock — Quest or Challenge · Ahead or Behind · Role

Why it helps: answers 'Am I winning this race, or do I need to slow it down?' after every action, and shows what each available action does to it before you take it.

Dojo hook: a pure function of App.state, recomputed in render(). A strip in the HUD plus a delta on each action chip. Size S.

Left out (YAGNI): any win %. It assumes nothing changes, and says so.

s3.text:
Threat & Exposure Map — Threat Assessment · Virtual Card Advantage

Why it helps: 'What happens if I don't answer this?' and 'what can they do to this?' — Ward, Evasive, Support, songs and the Device upgrade counted, hidden cards as honest odds.

Dojo hook: the card-text classifier (96.6% of removal text) plus the opponent decklist the Dojo already loads. Size M.

Left out (YAGNI): reading the opponent's mind. Their hand is treated as random from what you haven't seen.

s4.text:
Sequencing Coach — Sequencing

Why it helps: the invisible mistake — same plays, wrong order — shown with what you would have seen, and the best order found by trying them all.

Dojo hook: needs an ordered per-turn action log (turnActions is unordered today). 'Replay this turn' is just the turn-start bookmark that already exists. Size M.

Left out (YAGNI): suggesting new plays. It only reorders what you did.

s5.text:
Game Ledger — Tempo · Card Advantage · Card Value · Trading

Why it helps: a post-game review in the guide's three currencies, plus the turns that actually moved the race, and a receipt for every card.

Dojo hook: per-instance events (quest, challenge and banish already pass through _trackAction). Duels.ink replays carry the same facts in takenAction frames. Size M.

Left out (YAGNI): grading individual plays.

s6.text:
Turn Briefing — 'Every turn starts with questions'

Why it helps: you answer first, then the lenses check you. That builds the habit the guide asks for and measures how well calibrated your reads are.

Dojo hook: four taps at the start of a turn, saved on the turn node and checked with the Clock and Threat lenses. Size S once those exist.

Left out (YAGNI): streaks, cloud stats, leaderboards.
